_comment: Policy for dev/mods/mod_index.py: the facts about the mod index that a metafile cannot carry. The mods themselves, and which side each one installs on, live in .minecraft/mods/.index/*.pw.toml. After editing this file run `python .minecraft/dev/mods/mod_index.py generate`.

client_distro_only._comment: Metafiles kept by hand in distribution/client/mods/.index and in no other index. The dev client's prelaunch overlays them (reconcile_client_index.ps1); a tester's sync and the server never see them. Not part of the pack as delivered to testers. Removing them is the operator's call. None since 2026-10-18: FancyMenu and its libraries Konkrete and Melody were removed (no config/fancymenu existed, so FancyMenu customised nothing; operator 2026-10-18 23:05 EDT: "FancyMenu + Konkrete + Melody, chunky-player-pause, TenshiLib").

client_distro_url_mode._comment: CurseForge mods whose author switched off third-party API distribution: the API returns no download url even with a key and packwiz-installer stops. In the client distribution's index (the packwiz-installer form) they are pinned to the forgecdn url, which serves them regardless. The source keeps mode = 'metadata:curseforge', so the launcher and the PowerShell downloaders keep both of their candidate urls.

server_skip_patterns._comment: Substrings of jar names a dedicated server must never download or keep. A client-only mod of the pack needs NO entry here: `side = 'client'` in its metafile keeps it out of the server index and mod_index.py derives a pattern from its jar name. This list is for jars that are not in the index (retired mods, mods that were never in the pack) and for the patterns compiled into the launcher (icraft-core/src/packwiz.rs FORCE_SKIP_PATTERNS, which must stay a subset of this list until the launcher reads it from a file). No pattern may match a jar the server index installs: mod_index.py check fails if one does.
